description: This file defines the FencedCodeRenderer class responsible for rendering fenced code blocks in Markdown with specific handling for certain languages and syntax highlighting.

classes.name: FencedCodeRenderer
classes.description: A class that implements the rendering of fenced code blocks in Markdown, with support for syntax highlighting and special language handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the renderer with a new Highlighter instance.

methods.name: pre
methods.description: Creates an HTML 'pre' element containing a 'code' element with provided attributes and content.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main method to render a fenced code node, handling special cases for 'tex' and 'mermaid' languages, and otherwise rendering with syntax highlighting if applicable.

methods.name: renderCode
methods.description: Renders code content with optional syntax highlighting based on the language.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Extracts the language identifier from the info words of the fenced code block.
